full.description: This is a photomicrograph of a periapical dental lesion stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The image displays a root apex surrounded by inflammatory tissue showing a central dense area likely representing a periapical granuloma or abscess associated with endodontic pathosis. The section reveals chronic inflammatory infiltration and granulation tissue surrounding the root structure.

random.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of a histological specimen, likely representing a tooth root with periapical tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The section shows a tooth root structure at the top and a dense, inflamed periapical granuloma or abscess mass at the apex containing central bacterial colonies and inflammatory cells. The findings are characteristic of chronic periapical periodontitis with a periapical abscess or granuloma.
